data: DMG 78270 concerns the housing-cost additional amount, not the whole Pension Credit award. It states that an additional amount for housing costs is not allowed for claimants in a care home unless their absence from the dwelling normally occupied as home is temporary. The exception does not establish payment of care-home fees. DMG 78240 permits a trial stay of up to 13 weeks only with suitability assessment, intention to return if unsuitable and an unlet home; the overall absence limit is 52 weeks. DMG 78254–78257 set separate 52-week conditions including intention to return, no letting or subletting, a listed reason and expected duration. Permanent residence and expenditure met by Housing Benefit are separate exclusions. The complete paragraphs span adjacent pages.
